founding_principle: A consequential effect is a claim to be proved, not a sink to be matched.

proof_states.note: Requirement 5. ERROR is separate from UNKNOWN: 'we did not find out' and 'our analysis broke' require different responses. CONFLICTING never silently collapses to UNKNOWN.

obligations.note: Requirement 7. Independent: none may be inferred from another.

descriptors.note: Requirement 8. Retained separately and never obligations.

control_sub_descriptors.note: Each carries its own proof state. REI-002 measured a fixed-target effect at PROVEN_EFFECT with TRIGGER_CONTROL SUPPORTED and TARGET_CONTROL REFUTED.

implementation_candidate_kinds.note: Requirement 3: set-valued. OPAQUE_EXTERNAL is a first-class candidate, not an error; that is what allows a claim to exist for an unseen SDK.

selection_states.note: Selection is never performed by severity, danger, name plausibility or recency.

admissibility.note: Exactly two classes. A third, intermediate class would let name-derived signals drift into verdicts and would make the anti-gaming criteria unmeasurable.

ladder_tiers.note: Requirement 12. L8 is a terminal ABSTAIN state, not an evidence source.

stop_reasons.note: TIER_UNAVAILABLE and BUDGET_EXHAUSTED are never merged: the first is a property of the repository, the second of our configuration.

contradiction_resolutions.note: Requirement 14. Recency, severity, safety, tier rank, packet strength, majority vote and discarding a packet are all prohibited resolutions.

prohibitions.prohibition: The dangerous implementation is never selected because it is dangerous.
A callee name never establishes which implementation runs.
The presence or absence of a sink rule never establishes or excludes a candidate.

obligations.question: Is this invocation executed when the capability runs?

prohibitions.prohibition: Construction is not activation.
Import is not activation.
Conditional execution is not refutation; a guard is recorded as a CONDITIONS descriptor.

obligations.question: Does the effect leave the analysed state into an external system?

prohibitions.prohibition: HTTP or network dispatch may support ACTIVATION and BOUNDARY but never establishes OPERATION or PERSISTENCE.
prohibitions.source: requirement 9; REI-002 — every carrier used POST, yet an identical-source pair changed classification solely because the operation contract changed

prohibitions.prohibition: External boundary does not imply persistence.

obligations.question: Is the operation contract a mutation rather than an observation?

prohibitions.prohibition: The HTTP method never establishes the operation.
An identifier never establishes the operation; names generate hypotheses only.
Unknown SQL, command or operation semantics yield UNKNOWN; keyword-prefix inference on an unparsed statement is prohibited.
prohibitions.source: REI-002 — abstain on unknown SQL semantics

obligations.question: Does the mutation outlive the request?

prohibitions.prohibition: Dispatch is not persistence.
Persistence is independent of transport.
Guaranteed rollback refutes persistence.
Unknown commit versus rollback preserves uncertainty: UNKNOWN, never SUPPORTED.

descriptors.note: Coordinates with per-field resolution state plus scope. A fully unresolved target does not weaken the verdict.
Split into TRIGGER_CONTROL, TARGET_CONTROL and CONTENT_CONTROL because REI-002 measured a case where they disagreed.
Authority is not an obligation of effect (REI-002). An authorised effect is still an effect; an unauthorised read is still not an effect.
Guards, flags and branch predicates. Recorded, never used to refute ACTIVATION.

effect_classes.note: Requirement 18: the only class populated in v1.
Not implemented in v1; DELIVERY_ATTEMPT may not be read by the v1 verdict function. A message send is not a persistent-state mutation.
Payments. Not implemented in v1; SETTLEMENT may not be read by the v1 verdict function.
Not implemented in v1. Notably has no BOUNDARY obligation: in-process code execution is consequential without leaving the process.
Not implemented in v1; ROLLOUT_SCOPE may not be read by the v1 verdict function.
Not implemented in v1. Persistence is instance-dependent: a session-scoped grant is consequential without being durable.
Not implemented in v1. Notably has no OPERATION obligation: disclosure is consequential regardless of whether the operation mutates.
Not implemented in v1; ACTUATION may not be read by the v1 verdict function.
Not implemented in v1. Has no BOUNDARY obligation: capture is an intake, not an egress.
Not implemented in v1. IRREVERSIBILITY is not persistence: a physical action can be irreversible without writing durable state anywhere.

ladder.name: LOCAL_SYNTAX_BINDING
ladder.yields: call site, callee expression, argument shapes, literals, local bindings, enclosing control flow, guards

ladder.name: LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_WRAPPER
ladder.yields: bodies of functions and methods defined in the scanned workspace, including the wrapper chain

ladder.name: TYPES_DECLARATIONS_INTERFACES
ladder.yields: type annotations, stubs, .d.ts, interfaces, protocols, ambient declarations

ladder.name: PACKAGE_MODULE_PROVENANCE
ladder.yields: which external package or module the callee belongs to

ladder.name: WORKSPACE_DEPENDENCIES
ladder.yields: dependency manifests and lockfiles: the declared and pinned version in this workspace

ladder.name: PINNED_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE
ladder.yields: the actual source of the pinned dependency, when present in the analysed tree

ladder.name: MACHINE_READABLE_CONTRACT
ladder.yields: OpenAPI, JSON Schema, protobuf/gRPC, GraphQL SDL, SDK operation metadata, command specifications

ladder.name: UNDERLYING_OPERATION_SEMANTICS
ladder.yields: the SQL statement, document-store operation, shell command, transport or driver primitive the call reduces to

ladder.name: ABSTAIN
ladder.yields: nothing; terminal state reached when no tier below can be advanced within budget

budgets.exhaustion_behaviour: Descent stops on the affected path; unsettled necessary obligations remain UNKNOWN with no default and no inference; the stop reason BUDGET_EXHAUSTED is recorded with the specific budget name; unopened edges go on the frontier; the verdict is ABSTAIN unless an obligation was already legitimately REFUTED and closure C1-C6 holds, where C4 explicitly fails if the exhausted path contributed to the refutation.

counter_evidence_probes.question: Is a test double, mock, stub or fake injected at this site or by the enclosing fixture?
Is the callee monkey-patched, re-assigned or shadowed before this site?
Is the resolved symbol a re-export or alias whose ultimate target differs?
Is the site inside a type-checking-only block or ambient declaration?
Is the enclosing function dead: never referenced, never registered, never exported?
Is the site statically unreachable?
Is the site in test-only, example-only, fixture or generated-sample code?
counter_evidence_probes.note: Advisory on purpose: treating a file path as refutation is how real effects get suppressed.

counter_evidence_probes.question: Is the site behind a feature flag whose default is closed?
Is the transport or driver an in-memory, emulator, fake or local-stub implementation?
Is egress unconditionally disabled at this site?
Does the write terminate in a process-local buffer never flushed on any path?
Is the destination a loopback or ephemeral test endpoint?
Does the machine-readable contract classify this operation as an observation?
Does the underlying statement or command reduce to a read?
Is a dry_run, validate_only, plan_only or preview parameter passed at this site?
Is the mutation semantics conditional on an argument not resolvable at this site?
Is rollback or transaction abort guaranteed on every path from this site?
Is a dry-run, validate-only or plan-only mode in force?
Is the backing store in-memory, ephemeral, a temporary file removed on exit, or an emulator?
Is the operation documented as a no-op for the observed argument shape?
Is the commit-versus-rollback outcome undetermined at this site?
counter_evidence_probes.note: A positive finding does not refute persistence: it forces PERSISTENCE = UNKNOWN, because unknown commit versus rollback preserves uncertainty (REI-002). The only probe whose positive result yields ABSTAIN rather than NO_EFFECT.

counter_evidence_probes.question: Is the written state subject to a documented TTL shorter than the request lifetime?

qualified_call.note: Settles only the obligation it structurally witnesses; never persistence.

attr_call.note: Settles only the obligation it structurally witnesses; never persistence.

open_write.anchor: an argument-structure witness of a write mode

subprocess_deploy.anchor: an argument-structure witness of a command shape

github_rest_mutation.anchor: an argument-structure witness of a mutating REST shape

name_call.note: May raise and prioritise a claim; never establishes an obligation.

sql_execute_pattern.note: The settling evidence for OPERATION is L7 parsed operation semantics.

aref_001_dispositions.summary: REI is a non-gating annotation layer
aref_001_dispositions.reason: An annotation can only describe what already became a finding, so the describable set is the set of rule hits. The non-gating property survives as an integration constraint; the annotation-layer shape does not.

aref_001_dispositions.summary: The unit of inference is the sink call site, exactly one record
aref_001_dispositions.reason: The unit carries rule_id in its identity, so an unmatched invocation cannot produce a record. The unit becomes the invocation; identity is (capability_id, invocation_id, effect_class).

aref_001_dispositions.summary: Five inferred components: effect, kind, selector, scope, controllability
aref_001_dispositions.reason: Split along what must be proved versus what is described: effect becomes class plus five obligations; kind and selector fold into TARGET; scope is retained inside TARGET; controllability becomes CONTROL with three sub-descriptors, forced by REI-002's fixed-target case.

aref_001_dispositions.summary: The effect vocabulary is EffectType; no parallel taxonomy
aref_001_dispositions.reason: EffectType is a sink classification vocabulary populated by a per-rule-ID map, so adopting it makes the ontology of effects the catalogue of rules. It also cannot express the nine future classes that must not require persistence.

aref_001_dispositions.summary: The resource vocabulary is a new closed enum with a mandatory sentinel
aref_001_dispositions.reason: v1 needs no resource taxonomy. AREF-001's own B-02 analysis is accepted: the twenty members were derived from what the shipped rules suggest, not from real code, and vocabulary churn after release is unrecoverable.

aref_001_dispositions.summary: Selector extraction is declared as data, never per-rule code
aref_001_dispositions.reason: The catalogue is keyed by rule ID: the sink-centric ontology in data form. Replaced by the evidence acquisition ladder, keyed by what evidence is obtainable. The no-special-case-code prohibition survives and is widened to ban provider-specific signatures.

aref_001_dispositions.summary: unknown is the default; no name-based inference
aref_001_dispositions.reason: Kept, generalised and made the strongest rule in the architecture: identifier-anchored evidence is HYPOTHESIS_ONLY and can move nothing. Basis narrowed to REI-001B, since REI-001 is permanently INCONCLUSIVE.

aref_001_dispositions.summary: Certainty reuses AnalysisCertainty, weakest link, capped by reachability
aref_001_dispositions.reason: A single scalar cannot say which part is uncertain. Replaced by five per-obligation proof states plus one verdict. Weakest link survives as the conjunction, reachability as the ACTIVATION obligation, and the error-versus-unknown separation is promoted to ERROR and ANALYSIS_ERROR.

Prohibition kept for v1 and widened to all verdicts, states and descriptors. The modification is that the condition for lifting it is now preregistered in the R05/R06 thresholds, which AREF-001's B-01 could not do.

aref_001_dispositions.summary: Output is additive, versioned, and absent when off
aref_001_dispositions.reason: Kept and extended to claims, receipts and the ledger, with one addition: when the layer is enabled the coverage ledger is never absent.

aref_001_dispositions.summary: Opt-in for at least one minor release
aref_001_dispositions.reason: Kept with the rationale strengthened: AREF-002 is a larger change resting on controlled-corpus evidence only. Default-on is gated on R05/R06.

aref_001_dispositions.summary: resource_boundary and resource_effect never share a name
aref_001_dispositions.reason: Kept and observed: resource_boundary keeps its existing meaning as an entrypoint class, and the obligation is named BOUNDARY in its own namespace. Tested by AREF-002-T21.

aref_001_dispositions.summary: A disclosure counter is mandatory, not optional
aref_001_dispositions.reason: Kept and promoted from a counter pair to the first-class coverage ledger. The precedent is the shipped transitive-reachability failure: 2 followed edges against 3,297 unfollowed, 0 of 22 confirmed cases caught, invisible until an explicit disclosure was added.

aref_001_dispositions.summary: Rule-ID normalisation is explicit, language-aware and total
aref_001_dispositions.reason: Retained but demoted from a soundness concern to an evidence-provenance concern. A normalisation miss now costs an evidence packet, not an effect: the claim still exists and the ledger reports the gap by language.

invariants.statement: An invocation with zero matching sink rules and a single OPAQUE_EXTERNAL candidate instantiates an EffectClaim with all necessary obligations UNKNOWN and verdict ABSTAIN.
Injecting or removing every sink rule changes no claim's existence; it may change only evidence packets and priority.
A HYPOTHESIS_ONLY packet never changes an obligation state.
Obligation states are invariant under permutation of packet arrival order.
BOUNDARY = SUPPORTED with OPERATION = UNKNOWN never yields PROVEN_EFFECT.
An HTTP POST dispatch with no contract or operation-semantics evidence yields OPERATION = UNKNOWN and PERSISTENCE = UNKNOWN.
Identical source differing only in the operation contract yields different OPERATION states.
Guaranteed rollback on all paths yields PERSISTENCE = REFUTED, and NO_EFFECT only if C1-C6 hold.
Undetermined commit yields PERSISTENCE = UNKNOWN and verdict ABSTAIN, never SUPPORTED.
Contract-says-READ versus body-says-MUTATE yields CONFLICTING unless resolved-implementation precedence applies exactly; when it applies, the overridden packet is still present in the receipt.
Inter-candidate divergence yields UNRESOLVED_DIVERGENT and claim-level UNKNOWN, never CONFLICTING.
A BLOCKING probe that cannot complete forces ABSTAIN even when all five obligations are otherwise SUPPORTED.
TARGET_CONTROL = REFUTED with TRIGGER_CONTROL = SUPPORTED does not prevent PROVEN_EFFECT.
AUTHORITY present or absent never changes a verdict.
Budget exhaustion on a contributing path forces ABSTAIN, never NO_EFFECT.
ERROR on a necessary obligation yields ANALYSIS_ERROR, and the claim is not counted as a negative anywhere in the ledger.
Every emitted ABSTAIN carries a highest-tier-reached, a stop reason, an unresolved-obligation list and a frontier size.
Every emitted verdict has a schema-valid EffectReceipt whose answers object contains all eleven required keys.
A run producing zero PROVEN_EFFECT emits a coverage ledger, and no output path renders that as safe, clean or no effects.
No v1 verdict computation reads an obligation belonging only to a declared-unpopulated future effect class.
No AREF-002 identifier, field name or output key reuses resource_boundary or any existing name whose meaning differs.
A claim records the highest tier reached and exactly one stop reason.
Ascent is demand-driven: no tier is opened when no necessary obligation is UNKNOWN and addressable by it.
Every packet carries a byte-identical verbatim extract and a locator sufficient to retrieve it.
Dependency- and contract-sourced packets carry package name and pinned version.
No packet whose only anchor is an identifier is PROBATIVE.
No packet targets more than one obligation or more than one implementation candidate.
An unparsed statement or command yields UNKNOWN, never a keyword-prefix inference.
Prose documentation never yields a PROBATIVE packet.
The packet set and stop reason are identical across runs for a fixed workspace, configuration and budget.
TIER_UNAVAILABLE and BUDGET_EXHAUSTED are never merged into one reason.
Removing the entire sink-rule corpus changes no claim's existence and no claim's stop reason.
No tier consults a provider-specific identifier table to establish an obligation.
Descent terminates on every input; no unbounded recursion, no unbounded breadth.
For fixed workspace, configuration and budget, the opened-edge set and the frontier are identical across runs.
Budget exhaustion never changes an obligation from UNKNOWN to SUPPORTED or REFUTED.
Budget exhaustion on a contributing path makes NO_EFFECT unreachable.
A non-empty frontier relevant to the refuted obligation makes NO_EFFECT unreachable.
Every unopened relevant edge appears on the frontier with a reason distinguishing budget from unavailability.
A partially followed wrapper chain settles no obligation the unfollowed remainder would have settled.
Every L5, L6 or L7-via-dependency packet records package name and version resolution, including UNPINNED.
No descent performs network access, package installation, or execution of analysed code.
Caching changes cost only: cached and uncached runs produce identical packets and extracts.
Prioritisation changes only investigation order; two runs with different priority policies and unbounded budget produce identical verdicts.
An uninvestigated claim is reported with reason CLAIM_NOT_INVESTIGATED and is never counted as a negative.
Claim-level recall on EFFECT units is reported separately from PROVEN_EFFECT recall, isolating requirement 2.
Every emitted verdict has a schema-valid receipt whose answers object contains all eleven required keys.
For at least one EFFECT unit whose callee matches no rule in the sink corpus, a claim is instantiated and investigated, and its receipt names the tiers reached.
Re-running with the sink-rule corpus emptied changes no claim's existence and no claim's stop reason.
No provider-specific signature, table or identifier list is present in the implementation commit under test.
Two runs with identical configuration produce identical verdicts, packets, extracts and frontiers.
Every ABSTAIN carries a highest-tier-reached, a stop reason, an unresolved-obligation list and a frontier size.
No output path renders zero PROVEN_EFFECT as safe, clean or no effects.
The existing scanner gates are unchanged by enabling the layer: precision 16/16, soundness 6/6 and the recall figures are byte-identical with the layer on and off.
No obligation belonging only to a declared-unpopulated future effect class is read by the v1 verdict function.

invalidating_conditions: contamination of selection, specification, implementation or ground truth
a provider-specific patch between preregistration and reporting

prohibitions.prohibition: An EffectClaim may not require a known sink hit to exist.
Possible implementations may not be collapsed to a single value.
Evidence packets may not be merged across implementation candidates.
HTTP or network dispatch may not establish OPERATION or PERSISTENCE.
Names may not establish effects.
Known sink rules may not define whether an effect exists.
Budget exhaustion may not produce guessed semantics.
A contradiction may not be resolved by recency, severity, safety, tier rank, packet strength, majority vote or discarding a packet.
PROVEN_EFFECT may not be reached with a BLOCKING counter-evidence probe incomplete.
Zero findings may not be rendered as safe.
Future consequential effects may not be forced into persistence.
No provider-specific signature, table or identifier list may establish an obligation.
